reports.title: The Truth About Jeffrey Epstein’s Death
reports.description:
Seven years after Jeffrey Epstein’s death was ruled a suicide, the theory that Epstein didn’t kill himself is held by many. In this special report, Natalie Kitroeff sits down with the New York Times investigative reporters Jan Ransom, Steve Eder, Michael Rothfeld, and a New York Times Magazine reporter, Charles Homans, to investigate the central questions around Mr. Epstein’s death.

0:00 Inside the NYT Investigation
2:44 Chapter 1: Was Epstein Really Suicidal? 
12:12 Chapter 2: Could the Jail Fail This Badly?
24:40 Chapter 3: Was Murder Possible?

reports.title: Investigation: How the Tate Brothers Were Freed From Romania
reports.description:
For more than two years, Andrew and Tristan Tate were prohibited from leaving Romania, where they face accusations of trafficking dozens of women into a porn business. Our investigative reporter Megan Twohey reveals how the Tates courted powerful figures on the American right, from Tucker Carlson to Barron Trump, and gained their freedom.

Video by Megan Twohey, Christina Thornell, Christina Shaman, David Seekamp, Jon Miller, Joey Sendaydiego and James Surdam/The New York Times
